sources.title: 1.5B Shell Command Model Beats a 7B on a Laptop CPU | explainx.ai Blog
sources.snippet: A LoRA fine-tune of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B turns English into shell commands at 941MB, 0.59s median, 1.6GB RAM, no GPU. It scores 0.620 on InterCode-ALFA against an untuned 7B's 0.613.
